headline_marked: Meeting held as [[presidential election preparations begin]] in Parliament
headline: Meeting held as presidential election preparations begin in Parliament
summary: Acting Speaker Barrister Kaiser Kamal chairs a preparatory meeting as parties collect nomination papers for the 23rd President of Bangladesh.
details: A preparatory meeting regarding the presidential election has commenced at the National Parliament building. The session, chaired by Acting Speaker Barrister Kaiser Kamal, began at 11:00 AM on Tuesday, August 11.
The Election Commission (EC) announced the schedule on August 6. According to the timeline, the deadline for filing nomination papers is August 13, with scrutiny taking place on August 16.
The final date for withdrawing candidacy is August 18. Voting will be held in the National Parliament session room on August 20, from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM.

The BNP has already collected two nomination papers from the EC's returning officer's office. Several senior leaders, including Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, are being discussed as potential candidates.

Other names under consideration within the BNP include Dr. Khandaker Mosharraf Hossain, Dr. Moeen Khan, Nazrul Islam Khan, and Giasuddin Ahmed. Some party members suggest choosing a non-political leadership figure for the role.

A 11-party alliance led by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami has nominated Colonel (Retd) Oli Ahmed, Chairman of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), as their candidate. A delegation collected nomination papers on Monday.

The alliance's representative, Hamidur Rahman Azad, stated that the primary goal is to advance the democratic process and restore healthy democratic practices rather than focusing on victory or defeat.
The election follows the resignation of the 22nd President, Md. Sahabuddin, on July 24. The Chief Election Commissioner A M M Nasir Uddin has already met with the Speaker to coordinate the process.

headline_marked: 3 killed, 15 injured in [[bus-truck collision in Chandpur]]
headline: 3 killed, 15 injured in bus-truck collision in Chandpur
summary: The accident occurred on the Chandpur-Cumilla highway in Shahrasti Upazila when a bus attempted to overtake a sand-carrying truck.
details: A head-on collision between an Al Arafa bus and a hydraulic sand-carrying truck left three passengers dead and 15 others injured on Tuesday morning.
The accident took place around 9:30 AM in the Baniyachon area of Shahrasti Upazila, in front of the Patwari Bari.
Witnesses reported that the collision occurred when the bus attempted to overtake another vehicle on the Chandpur-Cumilla highway, causing both vehicles to veer off the road.
Fire service personnel and local residents rushed to the scene to rescue the trapped passengers.
The injured were transported to the Upazila Health Complex for medical treatment.
Shahrasti Police Station OC Mir Mahbubur Rahman confirmed the casualties but stated that the identities of the deceased have not yet been identified.
